articles.title: Tech outages are causing people to panic-buy
articles.summary: Recent tech outages across Microsoft, US airlines, and JPMorgan are driving consumers to stock up on emergency supplies. Costco is benefiting, with US comparable sales rising an estimated 11% to 12% in the final week of October compared with its typical 6% to 7% growth. Momentum continued into November as 21 of 26 generators tracked on Costco's website sold out. Sam's Club and home improvement retailers are also seeing increased demand.

articles.title: How Brands Are Going Viral With Advent Calendars
articles.summary: Beauty and CPG brands are filling TikTok feeds with advent calendars before Black Friday, since one box can fuel weeks of unboxings and debates when each door gives people a reason to keep watching. Burger King releases only 110 calendars a day, so fans follow the drop before the doors even open. Red Bull added one pack-exclusive flavor that has fans debating whether to buy the whole box for it.

articles.title: Make Them Type the Promo Code: Why a Little Effort Beats an Automatic Discount in Digital Shopping
articles.summary: Requiring customers to enter a promo code can generate more sales than automatically applying the same discount. A study found that a 15% discount redeemed through a promo code converted at 1.45%, compared with 0.91% for an automatic discount. The small action makes customers feel like they earned the deal, increasing their sense of value and likelihood of redeeming it. The tactic works best for modest discounts of 10% to 15%, but the effort should remain minimal. Additional steps can create frustration and eliminate the benefit.

articles.title: Google Deep Review (Tool)
articles.summary: Deep Review is an agentic AI system from Google Research that checks technical, scientific, and business documents for errors, inconsistencies, and weak claims. It supports PDFs and plain text. The tool provides two free document reviews per week.

articles.title: Agentic Shopping - Maybe Nobody Wants This
articles.summary: Agentic shopping faces consumer trust barriers as shoppers remain hesitant to let AI agents spend their money. While AI is used to research and compare products, retailers want to retain control of the actual purchase and customer relationship. Catalyst Brands is investing in loyalty programs to strengthen direct customer relationships across brands like JC Penney and Brooks Brothers.

articles.title: PayPal Said Honey Followed Last-Click Attribution, Which Was the Whole Problem
articles.summary: Last-click attribution can overstate the performance of advertising channels that capture sales rather than generate them. This is especially common in brand search, retargeting, coupon extensions, cart abandonment emails, and affiliate marketing. A 2015 eBay study found that turning off paid search ads had no significant impact on sales, even though attribution reports credited those ads with strong returns. Run incrementality tests to measure actual sales lift, exclude brand searches from automated campaigns, and revise affiliate terms to limit commissions for partners that only capture credit at checkout.

articles.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
articles.summary: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman oppose the idea of gradually handing control of society to AI as models become more powerful. Both believe humans must remain in charge but differ on how to prevent an accidental or intentional handover. Brockman stressed the growing need for better AI monitoring and security as models become harder to track through traditional chain-of-thought monitoring. Following a security breach, OpenAI redirected 25% of production engineers to security work.
